title: Lean by design — architecture calibrated to the strategic priority
Fully static SPA, no backend
Trunk-based delivery, single environment
Content and OG resolved at build time — not SSR or edge
Every public URL is SEO- and OG-complete
React + Vite + TypeScript
Tailwind with own components — no shadcn/ui
Brutalist mono visual identity, single theme
Self-hosted fonts — Space Grotesk + JetBrains Mono
Client-side routing, landing/CV split, back-compat redirects
UI in pt-BR; bilingual i18n deferred
snake_case in content/data, no mapping layer
S3 + CloudFront hosting with a URL-rewrite function
Terraform + Terraform Cloud, apply pipeline-only
GitHub OIDC deploy roles — immutable subject, least-privilege
Custom-domain email via iCloud+, not a mail service
Minimal infra security posture — no WAF, no CMK, SSM String-only
CI gates on the PR — E2E included, unit coverage ≥85%
Complete automated functional regression
SonarCloud quality gate, blocking
Application security posture — SAST + package-vulnerability scanning
Numeric SemVer, auto-bump + release on merge
Observability scoped to a static site
`profile.ts` is the canonical structured CV; cross-surface coherence
Backend-ful platform (BFF · DynamoDB · Cognito · SES · Lambda@Edge)
Lambda@Edge OG renderer
Backend link-unfurl / OG preview cards
GitFlow, staging + production two-environment
Offline-first installable PWA
Monorepo `tadeumendonca-pwa` consolidation
Shared regional WAF
Internationalize the site — light in-repo locale layer, ~~English-pinned crawlable baseline~~
GA4, consent-gated — a hard opt-in gate, not Consent Mode v2
The downloadable CV is a build-time PDF, printed from `/me` to a static asset
Curated repos render as static cards in long-form — a lone-URL facade + a leaf-bilingual field
Language is addressable — symmetric per-locale URL prefixes, per-locale prerender, hreflang + OG-per-locale
Article slugs are localized — a locale-matched slug per edition
Published content is distributed to LinkedIn **and** X, in the same batch
Reader shares are campaign-tagged — three immutable UTM parameters, no `utm_content`
Diagrams are Mermaid in the markdown body, compiled to inline SVG at build time
Per-article OG cards — generated at build time, keyed by the article key, derived in code
The trust root is bootstrapped out of band — Terraform never manages the OIDC provider, nor the role that runs Terraform
The dev-loop inventory is derived from the plugin repo — a committed manifest plus a cross-repo drift check, and the manifest may not say "denies" about a thing that only advises
Version digits carry content meaning — major and minor are a deliberate dispatch, patch stays automatic
A document title is an address — it leads with the section's `nav.*` label, never with the page's heading
A figure mermaid cannot draw is authored as a typed fence over fixed geometry — its arrangement asserted arithmetically, not pinned by a build artifact
